source: The Voter Poll by SSRS, CNN declared 2026 state Senate/Governor sources
source_universe: Selected current poll participants recalling each 2024 presidential choice
interview_choice_qualification: Successful recontacts use final choice; initial pre-election choice may remain after unsuccessful recontact. Not universally completed or administratively validated voting.
independence: CNN/NBC/MS NOW use the same SSRS study, not independent samples.
original_gates_preserved: AK GG and SG remain withheld as nonunique literal D/R comparisons; both published prior composition sums are97.
NH GG and SG remain withheld for unexplained prior composition sums95and97, not reconciled by four-row rounding.
A gap from100 is not assigned to nonvoters, an identifiable missing-response category or any prior coalition.
Alaska candidate-specific reported preferences do not identify a ranked-choice counting round or matched final-round transition.
display_interpretation: Native candidateAnswers.percentage is conditional on the displayed recalled prior choice; totalPercentage is separate prior composition.
Report literal named-candidate percentages without multiplying them by current totals or prior shares.
No pooling of the multiple Alaska Republican candidates; retain the literal Independent separately.
Dan S. Sullivan and Daniel J. Sullivan have different candidate IDs and parties and must not be conflated.
Preserve all four prior-choice rows and every native candidate, rounding and suppressed/null cells.
Unshown current-choice residuals are not inferred to be other-party votes or abstention.
The same respondents/offices are not additive; current-participant percentages are not original2024coalition rates or causal persuasion.
